value.rationale: Mean-first-arrival minimization alone misses a real reliability tradeoff: for each of the first three team sizes beyond the known mean-optimality cutoff, a physically admissible weak common reset makes search slower on average but less variable in absolute time. The sign reverses at the next natural adjacent size. Exact count-specific certificates make this a reproducible, model-relevant boundary, not an arbitrary parameter slice. No global variance threshold is claimed.
